nodes.label: strategy_version (semver+config_hash)
nodes.author: AI Engineer
nodes.rationale: Format {semver}+{config_hash} so an un-bumped config edit still records a distinct version via the hash; group A/B by portfolio/strategy_label, not the raw string, since adding config fields changed the base config_hash.

nodes.label: Cross-sectional rank normalization (P7/v3)
nodes.author: AI Engineer
nodes.rationale: engine.score_universe replaces each weighted sub-score with its percentile rank across the day's symbols before scoring; gated by scoring.rank_normalize, on only in v3.yaml.

nodes.label: Selectable strategy versions (A/B v1/v2/v3)
nodes.author: AI Engineer
nodes.rationale: load_strategy_config(label) deep-merges a config/strategies/<label>.yaml overlay onto base; each portfolio picks a version via portfolios.strategy_label; scheduler builds one engine per distinct version.

nodes.label: BrokerAdapter
nodes.author: Software Architect
nodes.rationale: Sacred seam: async Protocol with qty: Decimal plus async get_cash(); whole stack is async SQLAlchemy and a real broker is network-bound, Decimal qty supports fractional shares so a small budget can take a position.

nodes.label: PortfolioManager
nodes.author: Backend Architect
nodes.rationale: Depends on the BrokerAdapter Protocol, never a concrete broker; assembles AccountBalance from get_account_balance()+get_cash(), never the DB cash ledger directly, so MockRealBroker reconciles.

nodes.label: compute_cash (ledger-derived cash)
nodes.author: Backend Architect
nodes.rationale: Cash = Σdeposits − Σwithdrawals − Σbuys + Σsells over cash_movements and filled trade_orders; never stored as a mutable row, reconstructable after restart; STARTING_CASH does not drive paper cash.

nodes.label: JOB_SCHEDULE constant
nodes.author: Backend Architect
nodes.rationale: Scheduler↔API decoupling: /system/status derives next-run from the static JOB_SCHEDULE constant, no cross-process call; last-run/status/error come from job_runs.

nodes.label: backend.contracts (DTOs)
nodes.author: Software Architect
nodes.rationale: Single leaf DTO module (Pydantic v2, frozen) imported by every layer to avoid import cycles; distinct from session-bound ORM models, fields mirror DB columns 1:1.

nodes.label: Idempotent upserts (natural keys)
nodes.author: Database Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Jobs may rerun within misfire_grace_time=3600 so all writers use INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE on natural keys.

nodes.label: SvelteKit dashboard
nodes.author: Frontend Developer
nodes.rationale: Svelte 5 runes, static build served by FastAPI StaticFiles (no SSR), dark-only, single-user, read-only.

nodes.label: Typed API client
nodes.author: Frontend Developer
nodes.rationale: Treats live router/schema code as authoritative over the brief; Decimals arrive as strings (Decimal-safe JSON) parsed via toNum().

nodes.label: Chart components (Chart.js)
nodes.author: Frontend Developer
nodes.rationale: chartjs-chart-financial loaded lazily via dynamic import because it touches Chart.js internals at module-eval and throws under Node, which would 500 prerender.

nodes.label: strategy_version identifier (semver+config_hash)
nodes.author: Experiment Tracker
nodes.rationale: config_hash (SHA-256 over canonicalised resolved config) is the safety net: editing a weight without bumping semver still records a distinct version.

nodes.label: summary.json (FP&A join surface)
nodes.author: Experiment Tracker
nodes.rationale: Comparator consumes each run's frozen summary.json with identical keys and Financial Analyst formulas, computing deltas without ever re-deriving the numbers.
